title: West Bengal: Laws in 6 months to end ‘land jihad’, ‘love jihad’, says CM Suvendu
content: Bengal's Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari announced plans to implement the Uniform Civil Code. This initiative follows similar efforts in Uttarakhand and Gujarat, which recently received presidential assent. A committee led by Justice Ranjana Prakash Desai is drafting the proposed laws, with public hearings scheduled across five divisions. The committee aims to gather feedback from the public and rights bodies on the matter.

title: US withdraws all bombers from UK's Fairford base after suspected terror plot
content: The United States has withdrawn all bombers from RAF Fairford following an investigation into a suspected terror plot. The withdrawal occurred shortly after several people were arrested in connection with the alleged attack plans. British authorities indicated potential Iranian involvement, while Tehran firmly denied these claims and summoned the British ambassador. Additionally, the US maintains military presence in the Middle East with several ships heading to the region.

title: SIR strikes at heart of Constitution: Supreme Court judge Justice Ujjal Bhuyan
content: Justice Ujjal Bhuyan condemned the extensive deletion of voter names from electoral rolls due to the special intensive revision process. He emphasized that such actions undermine the core principles of the Indian Constitution and disenfranchise millions of citizens. Bhuyan highlighted that the right to vote is essential for free and fair elections in India. He urged that no citizen should be denied the right to vote without due process.

title: Faster registration, easier refunds: Reform rollout with GST 2.0
content: GST Council plans to unveil substantial reforms aimed at improving business processes and facilitating growth. The proposed changes involve streamlined registration, easier refunds, and a more efficient input tax credit system. Decriminalisation measures are also proposed to alleviate issues for businesses with minor offenses. A focus is on reducing discretionary practices and using technology to minimize litigation. These reforms seek to enhance operational efficiency for both small and large enterprises.

title: Marc Benioff, wife gave $100M to UCSF; 5 years later, children’s hospital opened
content: In 2010, Marc Benioff and Lynne Benioff contributed $100 million to build a new children's hospital at UCSF. Five years later, UCSF Benioff Children’s Hospital San Francisco officially opened with 183 beds for pediatric care. Before the hospital's opening, the Benioffs donated an additional $100 million to enhance healthcare services and research. The design prioritized family-centered care, including rooms for parents and outdoor recovery spaces.

title: Democracy in peril as voters illegally ousted: Ex-SC judge Nariman
content: Justice Rohinton Fali Nariman expressed concerns regarding the functioning of the Election Commission in India. He highlighted the issue of illegal removal of voters from electoral lists, especially in West Bengal. Nariman noted that 90 lakh voters were disenfranchised, with many not having access to justice. He emphasized the need for reform in the appointment process of election commissioners to ensure fairness.

title: Texas city to pay at least $175,000 over excess groundwater pumping at SpaceX site
content: The McGregor City Council has reached a settlement regarding penalties related to groundwater overpumping caused by SpaceX. The city will allocate $175,000 for this resolution and commit to a 25-year groundwater monitoring program. However, residents are concerned about who will bear these costs, urging that SpaceX should take financial responsibility.

title: 1 dead as Russian drones hit desi pharma plant in Ukraine
content: In Ukraine's Sumy region, six Russian drones attacked the Kusum Group's pharmaceutical plant, killing one engineer and injuring others. The main structure of the facility was largely destroyed during the targeted strike, which occurs amid a pattern of similar attacks. The company estimates damage from this incident could exceed $50 million, impacting operations significantly.

title: EAM Jaishankar says US has chosen to become 'lonelier power'
content: S Jaishankar stated that India aims to mediate in the Russia-Ukraine conflict through dialogue and diplomacy. India has recently proposed ideas addressing issues like grain and energy exports to both nations. Jaishankar emphasized America's changing global position and the implications of China's rise on international relations. India is also facing domestic repercussions due to the ongoing conflict, including commercial shipping disruptions.

title: UK farmers’ habitat work lifts corn buntings 346% and butterflies 183%
content: The resurgence of corn buntings and various wildlife species showcases the power of collaborative conservation work initiated by local farmers. Through the Martin Down and Allenford Farmer Clusters, projects were implemented to improve habitats throughout their farms. This endeavor has led to impressive increases in populations of butterflies and grey partridges over the past ten years. Continued financial investment and diligent monitoring are essential to uphold these successful biodiversity initiatives.

title: Meet Bailey Quinn Frank, eighth-grader who built low-cost bacterial air sampler
content: Bailey Quinn Frank has created a groundbreaking air sampler designed to enhance health surveillance in rural areas. Utilizing basic materials such as fans and filters, this device collects airborne bacterial DNA. Findings revealed notable variations in bacterial composition between indoor and outdoor spaces. As a finalist in the Thermo Fisher Scientific Junior Innovators Challenge, Bailey exemplifies the use of practical tools in tackling public health issues.

title: MacKenzie Scott gave $30M to housing nonprofit; a year later, it unveiled 10-year plan
content: MacKenzie Scott has made headlines with her unprecedented $30 million donation to Housing Trust Silicon Valley, marking the organization's largest-ever gift. This investment is set to bolster affordable housing options throughout the Bay Area, as the trust plans to enhance its loan fund and expand various housing initiatives over the next decade.

title: Retired FBI agent’s search helps rediscover 30 forgotten apple varieties
content: In 2012, retired FBI agent Dave Benscoter began searching for forgotten apple varieties after discovering unidentified trees in a churchgoer’s orchard. What started as curiosity became a decade-long mission. Alongside fellow apple enthusiasts, Benscoter has helped rediscover 30 once-lost varieties while preserving historic apple trees across the Pacific Northwest for future generations.

title: 'Look Out Circular' against parents of man who secretly took away child to US
content: The Supreme Court has indicated consequences for parents of a man who abducted his daughter to the US. This decision came during a case regarding child custody between NRI couples. The father has been ordered to return to India with the child within four weeks. If he fails to comply, his parents will face legal consequences. The court emphasizes the importance of the child's connection with her mother.

title: 25p/kg wheat MSP hike an 'insult': Samyukta Kisan Morcha
content: Farmer organisations represented by Samyukta Kisan Morcha rejected the government's announced minimum support prices for Rabi crops. They described the small increase for wheat as an insult rather than acceptable compensation. SKM called for a revision of MSPs and urged states to offer bonuses to farmers. Additionally, they highlighted the impact of rising diesel and input costs on farming.

title: Lewis Hamilton sells $43.9 million NYC penthouse for $49.5 million
content: Lewis Hamilton bought the 8,908-square-foot Penthouse H at 443 Greenwich Street for $43.99 million in 2017 but never lived there. He listed it for $57 million in 2019 before it entered contract at $49.5 million in 2021. The sale gave him a gross gain of about $5.5 million, while Jennifer Gates was later linked to the property.

title: Andy Reid reveals what makes Travis Kelce and Patrick Mahomes different
content: Kansas City Chiefs’ head coach Andy Reid shares more about Travis Kelce and Patrick Mahomes ahead of facing the Las Vegas Raiders.

title: From India to Australia: How 6 countries got caught up in flydubai terror
content: On September 30, the flydubai Flight FZ1073 faced a cockpit attack when Omani co-pilot Hammam al-Hammami stabbed Captain Smit Machchhar. The injured pilot bravely opened the cockpit door, allowing crew and passengers to subdue the co-pilot. The flight was diverted to Tabuk, Saudi Arabia, where al-Hammami was apprehended by authorities. Investigations have since been undertaken by several countries into al-Hammami’s background and possible extremist ties.

title: UK: 2 teenagers jailed for 10 years for arson at Indian restaurant in London
content: Two 17-year-old teenagers were sentenced to 10 years for an arson attack at Indian Aroma. The incident occurred on August 22, 2025, when they threatened diners with weapons. Their actions led to severe burns for multiple victims, including a couple who suffered life-threatening injuries. The court emphasized the planning and intent behind the attack, which resulted in serious harm. The motive for this violent act remains unknown.

title: ‘Thanks for the gift’: Pant’s 29th birthday made special as RoI reclaim Irani Cup
content: Rishabh Pant's birthday happened to coincide with a remarkable comeback as the Rest of India triumphed over Jammu and Kashmir in the Irani Cup. Despite falling behind initially, the team rallied to secure a 167-run victory. Although Pant missed the action due to illness, he joined in the post-match festivities. Mukesh Kumar's exceptional bowling and young talent Ravichandran Smaran's innings were pivotal.

title: Kashmiri teacher fights period stigma, one village at a time
content: Aasima Jan works diligently in north Kashmir, focusing on menstrual health awareness to help girls stay in school. She began her efforts after witnessing the stigma around menstruation affecting attendance rates among female students. Monthly sessions in villages educate families about menstrual hygiene and encourage open discussion about the topic. Aasima also distributes sanitary pads, highlighting their importance for health and hygiene.

title: Jammu and Kashmir: Pakistani prisoner dies by suicide in jail
content: Shahid Imran, a 36-year-old Pakistani undertrial prisoner, was found unconscious in his jail cell early Sunday. He was a resident of Sargooda district in Punjab, Pakistan. Authorities rushed him to GMCH where doctors declared him brought dead. The incident occurred at the high-security central jail in Jammu. An investigation into the circumstances surrounding his death is likely to follow.

title: Asian Games: PM Modi congratulates Team India, hails ‘passion and sporting spirit’
content: Prime Minister Narendra Modi praised the inspiring performances of Indian athletes at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games, where India clinched a remarkable total of 85 medals, including 21 golds, finishing fourth overall. The Games were highlighted by record-breaking efforts, particularly in athletics, showcasing the talent of emerging athletes. Modi called for enhanced focus on grassroots sports development to empower future generations.

title: Sharad Sagar left US to work in India; years later, White House invited him back
content: After studying in the US, Sharad Vivek Sagar decided to return to Bihar, despite his friends' disbelief. They teased him, challenging his choice, and he quipped that only a White House invitation would lure him back. Years later, his dedication to education earned him an invite from Barack Obama, turning a light-hearted jest into reality and representing his commitment to his home state.

title: Asian Games: PT Usha names Kumkum Mohod, Sujeet Kalkal as Team India’s MVPs
content: At the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games, Kumkum Mohod and Sujeet Kalkal shone brightly, capturing the spotlight with their remarkable achievements. Mohod clinched three medals, including two golds, breaking South Korea's stronghold in archery. Meanwhile, Kalkal staged an impressive comeback to win gold in men's 65kg freestyle wrestling. Indian Olympic Association president PT Usha lauded their tenacity, announcing plans to celebrate their triumphs in an upcoming ceremony.

title: Lionel Messi's long road from 'outsider' to Argentina’s undisputed leader
content: Messi moved to Barcelona as a teenager. While Spain tried to convince him to play for them, Argentina had limited knowledge of the youngster from Rosario.

content: Kohli has confirmed that the 2027 edition will be his last ODI World Cup for India, meaning the team will have to find a replacement at No. 3, a position he has held for many years.

title: ‘Beti Bachao Delhi Police Se!’: CJP’s Abhijeet Dipke on Neha Bora’s detention

During the protest, AISA president Neha Bora was reportedly detained by the Delhi Police in a vehicle. Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) workers, including Saurabh Bhardwaj, were also detained while protesting at India Gate. Bhardwaj alleged mistreatment by officers during his detention, questioning the treatment of the common man.

title: Jio Platforms IPO likely by Oct-end; $3.8 bn issue, $143-146 bn company valuation: Report
content: Jio Platforms is preparing for its stock market debut with an estimated issue size of $3.8 billion, which could set records. The IPO aims for a valuation of $143-146 billion, with filings expected in mid-October. Reliance Jio’s expansion includes telecom, cloud, AI, and services, reporting significant financial growth recently. Past investors include tech giants like Meta and Google, contributing substantial capital to the company.

title: 'Pulled out dagger’: 'Drunk' driver attacks BJP MLA in Assam; 2 home guards injured

The driver, believed to be intoxicated, rammed a parked vehicle belonging to party workers. Sarmah stated that the police initially handled the situation, but it escalated when the driver brandished a dagger. During the confrontation, two home guards sustained injuries while trying to intervene.

title: Yeh Rishta actor Mohsin Khan gets married to Tamanna

The photo, captioned 'The Day MashaAllah,' was met with excitement. Shortly after, videos of the couple enjoying a dance together emerged online. Following their engagement in August, Mohsin affectionately called her his 'Person,' prompting an outpouring of congratulations from admirers.

title: ‘Learn and keep moving forward’: Bindra’s message to Team India as LA 2028 beckons

While acknowledging India’s notable successes, he insisted on a careful assessment of both triumphs and failures. With the Los Angeles Olympics approaching, Bindra pointed out the necessity of stable athlete growth and targeted training.

title: Why are gold prices falling and will the decline continue?
content: International gold prices have fallen 26% from the record high of $5595 seen on January 29 this year. Indian gold prices peaked at the same time and are down around 23%. More recently, gold prices which rose to Rs 1,64,773/10 gm levels on MCX futures contract in the last week of August had fallen by more than 10% to a low Rs 1,45,991/10 gm levels last week.

title: Did Israel ignore warnings? UAE shared info about flydubai crew & Omani co-pilot
content: The UAE shared passenger and crew information with Israel before a FlyDubai flight whose Omani co-pilot allegedly attacked the captain and tried to seize control, AP reported. The co-pilot had reportedly been barred from flying by Oman over extremist concerns before joining FlyDubai. The incident has raised questions over Israel’s foreign-flight security system, despite previous warnings about inadequate checks and limited resources within the Transportation Ministry.

title: ‘I want him to reach that mark’: Gavaskar’s special wish for Rohit before retirement

While there were complaints about accommodations and transportation, the Olympic Council of Asia celebrated a nearly 20% revenue increase. With around 17,000 athletes taking part, the event demonstrated the power of sports to unite.

title: Watch: Russian drones hit Kyiv bridge; German chancellor arrives to sirens
content: german chancellor's arrival comes amid air raid sirens, explosions and activation of air defence systems . video footage shows the drone hitting the bridge, sending a plume of fire and black smoke into the air while vehicles were still travelling across it .

title: Zelenskyy claims Putin shared jet-drone technology with North Korea
content: the comments come as Russia has intensified its offensive against Ukraine . a Russian drone struck the Pivnichnyi bridge in the Ukrainian capital on Sunday . the comments deepen concerns over growing military cooperation between Moscow and Pyongyang .

title: 'More involved': EAM confirms India has 'gone beyond advocacy' to end Ukraine war
content: external affairs minister says india has stepped beyond traditional advocacy to broker peace and operational agreements between Russia and Ukraine . jaishankar: "we are seeing today an unfortunate conflict. this will require dialogue and diplomacy. there has to be negotiations in this regard"

title: Day 3, bigger showdown: CEC protest sparks clashes, detentions in Delhi
content: protests are part of a wider agitation over alleged irregularities in the Election Commission’s functioning, the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls and alleged mass deletion of voters . protesters briefly clashed with security personnel as they tried to cross the barricades .

title: 'I do not accept': Chavan rejects Raj Thackeray’s poll boycott call amid SIR row
content: Prithviraj Chavan rejects Navnirman Sena chief Raj Thackeray's call to boycott elections . he said participation in elections was a democratic right . Chavan made the remarks amid a political confrontation over the SIR .

title: CEC Gyanesh Kumar faces fresh Kerala vigilance probe in 2006 case
content: state govt orders fresh vigilance inquiry into corruption allegations linked to the Kerala State Transport Project and the 2006 death of a Malaysian engineer associated with it . home minister says fresh inquiry will examine all related aspects . move comes amid opposition protests against Kumar over special intensive revision of electoral rolls across states .
